description.value: Valley Sushi is a Japanese cuisine and sushi bar in Lynn Valley, North Vancouver, serving authentic Japanese food for over a decade. Located in a shopping centre unit on Lynn Valley Road, it offers dine-in, online ordering, and delivery. A touring cyclist riding through the Lynn Valley corridor would find a full sit-down meal option with a broad Japanese menu.
